block.comment: Measure the voltage on this analog input. On ATmega168/328, the ADC returns 0–1023; other boards may use a different ADC range. A potentiometer wiper or analog sensor connects here.
Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.
Purpose: Show a changing potentiometer value on a 16×2 I2C LCD. Hardware: use Connections to check pin ownership for your selected board. Open the comment bubbles on the main steps for explanations.
